usedFor: Memberful holds members, subscriptions and orders, and Facebook Messenger carries a note to the person through “Send Message from Page”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a subscription is renewed” in Memberful, then “Send Message from Page” in Facebook Messenger
bestTemplate.why: A renewal passes on member and subscription details, and the action sends a message to a user from a page.

watchOut: “Send Message from Page” reaches someone outside your business, so each message waits for your approval.
